plugins.name: Cloudflare DNS
plugins.description: ACME DNS-01 challenge provider for wildcard certificates without exposing ports 80/443. Perfect for internal services and multi-domain setups.

plugins.name: Caddy Security
plugins.description: Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting (AAA) app and plugin. Implements Form-Based, Basic, Local, LDAP, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, SAML Authentication. MFA/2FA with App Authenticators and Yubico. Authorization with JWT/PASETO tokens.

plugins.name: Cloudflare KV
plugins.description: Leverage Cloudflare Workers KV for globally distributed edge certificate storage with ultra-low latency access.

plugins.name: Brotli Compression
plugins.description: Modern Brotli compression providing 15-25% better compression than gzip for faster page loads and reduced bandwidth costs.

plugins.name: Rate Limit
plugins.description: Enable rate limiting for HTTP requests to prevent abuse and manage traffic spikes.

plugins.name: Caddy WAF
plugins.description: Web Application Firewall providing OWASP CRS rules, IP blocking, rate limiting, and request inspection to protect against common web attacks.

examples.name: Cloudflare DNS
examples.title: Caddyfile - Wildcard Certificate
examples.note: Set your API token as environment variable: export CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=your_token_here

examples.name: Caddy Security
examples.title: Caddyfile - Form-Based Authentication
examples.note: Users can self-register via /portal/register. Configure providers like Google, GitHub, etc. via the security app.
